svg.title: MOD-17473 BG-only serialization versus master
svg.desc: Six AWS benchmark cases. Each has ten adjacent pairs, balanced five master-first and five BG-only-first. Raw paired percentage changes are shown as opaque dots and triangles. Diamonds are geometric means and bars are order-stratified bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals.
svg.text: 10 adjacent pairs / 20 observations per case · 5 master-first / 5 BG-first · 10,000 rows/reply
WORKERS is per shard; the public coordinator serializes on a BG thread in every cluster case.
Each marker is (BG-only / master − 1) × 100 for one adjacent pair. Opaque shape and color both encode order.
